mentions.name: backlog.fyi
mentions.description: A privacy-respecting, fully open-source personal task manager with a weekly planning session so tasks don't get forgotten. Tasks can be added easily by forwarding an email or sending a Telegram message. Free of ads, trackers, and subscriptions, and self-hostable for those who want to run it themselves.
mentions.problem: Simple task tools like Microsoft To Do, Google Tasks, text files, and Post-it notes were too basic and easy to forget about, while sophisticated task managers were overkill, asked for too many permissions, and turned notifications into noise.
mentions.audience: A person managing their own day-to-day personal tasks; the author uses it for their own daily planning.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on https://backlog.fyi, a personal task manager, for the last few months.
mentions.author: kind_of_serious
